facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's own page states that SIS-MA's aggregate instance and the other DHIS2 instances are managed by the ministry's Departamento de Informação para Saúde (DIS), with a mother instance holding the master list of organisational units; the page is undated, so the published date is used.
